segments.heading: GTA 6: Check These 3 Things
segments.narration: Before you believe any GTA six launch rumor, check these three things.

segments.heading: 1. Official Release Updates
segments.narration: First, check Rockstar Games' official newswire for the latest release information.

segments.heading: 2. Platform Details
segments.narration: Second, verify supported platforms directly from the official game page.

segments.heading: 3. Real Footage
segments.narration: Third, look for the official source of any viral gameplay clip. Fan edits are not confirmed gameplay.

long.title: GTA 6: How to Separate Official News from Rumors
long.description: An original GTA 6 commentary explainer. Always verify updates at Rockstar Games. #GTA6 #Gaming

segments.heading: GTA 6: News vs Rumors
segments.narration: GTA six attracts an enormous amount of online speculation. Here is a quick guide to checking what is actually confirmed.

segments.heading: Start With Rockstar
segments.narration: Official announcements and trailers are the best starting point. Look at the publisher's own website and verified channels.

segments.heading: Check the Original Clip
segments.narration: A short clip may be a fan animation, an older game, or edited footage. Always trace it to the original uploader.

segments.heading: Release and Platforms
segments.narration: Release dates and supported platforms can change. Check current official product information before repeating a claim.

segments.heading: Label Theories Clearly
segments.narration: Fan theories are fun, but they should be labeled as theories rather than confirmed features.

segments.heading: Subscribe for Analysis
segments.narration: Thanks for watching Play With Jey. Subscribe for gaming analysis that clearly separates evidence from speculation.
